title: Scale why
description: The answers that lead to a scheme's color.definition.steps answer, earliest first, read from each answer's because list. Drawn by the ScaleWhy composite beside the reason in words.

steps.description: Each answer in the chain; the last is color.definition.steps.

question.description: The question's id, such as brand.q1.

group.description: The title of the question's group in the grammar, such as Brand or Color.

option.description: The id of the option the scheme chose.

answer.description: The label of that option, from the grammar.

why.description: The scheme's own reason for the answer.

repeatsLabel.description: True when the why adds at most one word of content to the answer label, such as Bold and confident. under Bold. The page hides such a why.
